caption: The drawing shows a long, high-waisted dress with long sleeves and no figure wearing it. The dress has a white or cream-colored bodice and skirt, with a gathered bust and empire waistline. The skirt is loose, flowing, and has a subtle pattern of small, light gray floral designs distributed evenly throughout the fabric. Over the dress, there is a fitted, long-sleeved jacket or bolero in a deep red or burgundy color, decorated with green and gold floral or leaf embroidery on the sleeves and along the edges. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with the focus solely on the dress itself. The artist's signature appears in small text at the lower left corner.
title: Spencer
